title: Montauk experiments

tellings.quote: I believe that there was like this machinery they found at Montalk and blanking on the name of the author of the book, but Preston something

plain: Some kind of machinery was found at Montauk, a town at the tip of Long Island, New York, where people say secret experiments were run between the 1950s and the 1960s. Michels brings this up from a book he can't quite place, saying only that the author was "Preston something," meaning the writer Preston Nichols, and that he believes the machinery was really there. He tells it because, if it were true, it would mean strange government work went on in that spot.
